title: Fact check: The drug cut deaths by half
instructions: You grade a public claim against the pinned transcript. Grade it true if the transcript supports it as stated, mostly true if it supports it with minor qualifications, misleading if it is accurate only for a part or a period the claim does not name, and false if the transcript contradicts it. Quote nothing beyond what you need.

context.content: Example trial summary. In patients over 65 with stage 3 disease, deaths fell from 12 percent to 6 percent at 24 months. In the full trial population, deaths fell from 9 percent to 7 percent, a difference the authors describe as not statistically significant.
The claim, as posted on Nov 3: "The new drug cut deaths by half."
Fact-check desk style guide. Grade the claim as worded, not what the speaker may have meant. Name the sentence that decides the grade.

question.prompt: Grade the claim "The new drug cut deaths by half."
